protocol: v5 fixed-window BETA subject expansion; D1/D2 evaluation only
new_test_selection: First five unused BETA subject filenames by SHA256('expanded-v1:' + filename), ascending, from S1..S70 excluding all 24 subjects in runs/v2-beta-subject-isolated/subject_roles.json; frozen before reading signal
selection: earliest epoch with maximum development subject macro accuracy, separately for each training group and seed
primary_unit: subject; each original trial contributes one first-window prediction
confirmation: All six EEGNet checkpoints and the fixed FBCCA rule freeze before any new-test or D1/D2 labels are read. Report all seeds, no winner selection on confirmation data.
preprocessing: crop raw 375-sample window before per-channel 6-90 Hz zero-phase filter and within-window standardization; BETA onset 0.5 s plus 0.14 s latency; no D1/D2 calibration
known_limitations: Development subjects have repeated historical exposure
D1/D2 are previously viewed small examples, not blind tests
Five new test subjects give a wide uncertainty interval
Formal competition metadata and cross-dataset channel alignment remain provisional
